svg.title: SafarSetu — plan your work around the buses, metro and trains you can actually catch
svg.desc: Project banner for SafarSetu. A sample plan shows stops A, B and C with a be-there-by time, and a calm alert: no need to rush, your train is 30 minutes late, leave at 10:40.
